summary: Release monag 0.3.1 with fixed dependency metadata

delivery.outcome: Bump 0.3.0 -> 0.3.1 across the three versioning.files targets and record the release in CHANGELOG, so the dependency-metadata fix from ticket-024 (pyyaml>=6,<7, rich>=14,<16) reaches users. PyPI does not allow replacing a released version, and the published 0.3.0 ships metadata that makes `monag audit`/`resume`/`export`/`panel` crash with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'yaml' after a clean install.
nonGoals: No source or behaviour change relative to 0.3.0; only the version string and changelog move.
No dependency declaration changes -- those landed in ticket-024 and are merely being released here.
goal.yaml keeps publishing.enabled/publish_enabled false; the upload is run explicitly, not by flipping the repository's safety flag.

architecture.decision: Edit the version string in VERSION, pyproject.toml and src/monag/__init__.py (the exact set goal.yaml declares under versioning.files), add a CHANGELOG entry stating why 0.3.1 exists, then build and verify the wheel against a clean virtualenv before uploading.
architecture.rollback: Revert the release slice through protected review; a published PyPI version cannot be replaced, only superseded.

validation.evidence: The 0.3.1 wheel installs into a clean virtualenv and the full suite passes against the installed package.
Independent read of PyPI shows 0.3.1 with pyyaml in requires_dist and the command runs without the import error.
